title: イベントプロデューサーの評価アップ

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Wow… Her movements have gotten even more refined—and she's built up more stamina as well!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: You can tell how hard she's been working. I can't wait to showcase her talent on stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello seems to be moved and inspired after watching <chrname> train.
